title: SectionViewStyle group-3 label measurement overlay insertion
scope: Preserve typed label text-height and label-offset edits when raw group-3 code-40 occurrences are absent
Exercise the second group-3 double with a default first-slot placeholder
Keep the control isolated from unrelated named-object callback tests

production: The same-version SectionViewStyle raw overlay now inserts missing group-3 code-40 label text height/offset values when typed values differ from defaults.
A changed label offset with a default/missing label-height slot emits the height placeholder first, preserving repeated-value ordinal decoding.
tests: Generated ASCII and Binary controls remove both original group-3 code-40 values, retain the default text height, and change the label offset.
The test checks the exact ordered raw group stream and same-version typed readback, alongside group-2 color/lineweight insertions in the same generated style control.

limitations: This proves local same-version raw overlay preservation and typed readback for generated inputs only. Autodesk's SectionViewStyle property API identifies label text height and offset but is not a DXF group-code schema; native producer/consumer behavior, cross-version writing, and rendering remain unqualified.
